semantic.justification: Source decomposition of sw/source/writerfilter/rtftok/rtfdocumentimpl.ts: Finish, ApplyStyleDefinition, ApplyParagraph. Existing native algorithms operate on the original class instance and retain original state, method ordering and observable behavior. No independent scanner or parser state is introduced. Full upstream and compiled differential parity remain unverified. S3HW1E named character-style integration: stylesheet cs entries materialize actual SwCharFormat owners separately from paragraph collections, resolve same-family forward parents, and apply represented character properties. Real SwFormatCharFormat/SwTextCharFormat hints retain selected style identity, direct-property precedence and group/plain restoration; the native current character-style index remains distinct from the selected rStyle reference for failed lookups. RTF OutputTextCharFormat emits original cs IDs before repeated effective properties, as the source requires. Character-style positive baseline percentages are kept separate from paragraph automatic superscript. The represented RTFSprms getDefaultSPRM character families reset absent run bold/italic/underline/font/height/color properties present in the flattened style reference; non-defaulted strikeout/highlight/escapement/kerning inherit. Plain clears direct kerning rather than inventing a false direct override. Native style-default helper compiled unchanged with original generated OOXML IDs under ASan/UBSan yields9 defaults among35 queried tokens; scalar/nested value carriers are not full RTFValue/RTFSprms or mapper ABI. Existing run-projection/string-sink bindings remain explicit; complete native property graph, duplicate style-index semantics, linked styles, paragraph-style cs/s cross-family behavior, CJK/CTL import association, script/bidi and remaining whole-filter obligations are unverified. Temporary imported automatic style handles/sets are disposed, and export run item sets now use generator-scoped ownership.
